system.title: System
system.subtitle: What this machine offers for training and chat.

gpus.noneBody: Training and chat run on the CPU, which is much slower. Only small models are practical.

hf.title: HuggingFace account
hf.why: Some models and private datasets need a HuggingFace token to download.
hf.tokenHint: Starts with hf_. Create one in HuggingFace settings, under Access Tokens.
hf.removeBody: Models already downloaded keep working. Models that need a token can't be downloaded until one is saved again.
hf.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change the token.
